<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/users/{userId}/avatar"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the user's Gravatar image at 128 pixels, fetched and cached by the server so neither the user's email nor the viewer's address reaches Gravatar. The server caches an image, or the absence of one, for up to 24 hours, so a changed email or Gravatar image can take that long to appear.
